title: Angular Velocity Formula
text: Recall that the angular velocity can be found by dividing the tangential velocity by the radius: $$\omega=\frac{v}{r}$$.

title: Check Your Units
text: Convert $$500\,\text{km/h}$$ to $$\text{m/s}$$ before using the formula, and remember that one revolution is $$2\pi$$ radians.
